# Rejaka Abimanyu Susanto

> Full-stack developer and tech enthusiast based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. MTCNA certified, student at SMKN 2 Depok Sleman (Information System, Networking, and Application), currently a Fullstack Developer Intern at PT Botika Teknologi Indonesia. Builds comprehensive, reliable web systems using Next.js, React, Axum, and Rust. Open for freelance work.

This site is a personal portfolio featuring a blog, project showcase, work experience, achievements, and resume — built as a fast, static site with Astro, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rejaka.id/): Introduction, latest blog posts, work experience, and featured projects.
- [Blog](https://rejaka.id/blog): Technical articles on web development, networking, IoT, and cybersecurity.
- [Projects](https://rejaka.id/projects): Showcase of web, mobile, and tooling projects with links to live demos and repositories.

- [Achievements](https://rejaka.id/achievements): Competition placements and recognitions in web development.
- [Resume](https://rejaka.id/resume): Downloadable/printable CV with skills, experience, education, and achievements.

## Blog posts

- [Smart Hydroponic: IoT-Based Monitoring and Control System](https://rejaka.id/blog/smarthydroponic): Building a 24/7 automated hydroponic monitoring and pump-control system using ESP8266, sensors, MQTT, n8n, and a Gemini-powered Telegram bot.
- [System Prompt for n8n Hydroponic AI Agent](https://rejaka.id/blog/n8nsystemprompt): System prompt design for an n8n-based hydroponic AI agent (Indonesian language).
- [n8n JSON Template for Hydroponic Monitoring and Control System](https://rejaka.id/blog/n8njson): Ready-to-import n8n JSON workflow template for hydroponic monitoring and control.
- [MikroTik Firewall Filter Rules: Allow, Drop, and Access Control](https://rejaka.id/blog/mikrotikFirewall): Two-router lab walkthrough covering static routing, NAT, and firewall filter rules with real test results.
- [Mail Server Explained: How Email Actually Works Behind the Scenes](https://rejaka.id/blog/mailServer): Breakdown of MUA, MTA, and MDA roles and how email travels between domains.
- [CIA Triad Explained: The Foundation of Cybersecurity](https://rejaka.id/blog/CIA): Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability fundamentals with real-world case studies including a ransomware attack analysis.
- [How to Install Go Version Manager (GVM) on Linux](https://rejaka.id/blog/gvmInstall): Step-by-step guide to installing and using GVM to manage multiple Go versions.
- [Node Version Manager (NVM) Tutorial on Linux](https://rejaka.id/blog/nvmTutorial): Installing and using NVM to manage multiple Node.js versions.
- [Free Services Every Developer Should Know About](https://rejaka.id/blog/freeDevServices): Curated list of free developer tools and services (databases, VPS hosting, image CDN, and more).

## Featured projects

- [JaMak: Jaringan Masyarakat (Community Network)](https://rejaka.id/projects/jamak): Community network platform improving connectivity and access to services in rural areas.
- [Rejaka F1](https://rejaka.id/projects/rejaka_f1): Formula 1 information platform with race schedules, driver and constructor standings, built with Next.js, MariaDB, and TypeScript.
- [NKPol Profile Website](https://rejaka.id/projects/nkpol_profile): Profile website for the NKPol event booth organizer.
- [JogjaWaskita](https://rejaka.id/projects/jogjawaskita): Civic engagement platform with agentic AI-assisted public issue reporting and government analytics dashboards, built with Next.js, Axum, MariaDB, and Rust.
- [Blessedly](https://rejaka.id/projects/blessedly): AI-powered mental health companion with journaling, mood tracking, and emotional support, built with Axum, MariaDB, and Rust.
- [Alimentify](https://rejaka.id/projects/alimentify): AI-powered meal nutrition analyzer with an AI agent for diet guidance, built with Next.js, MongoDB, Axum, and Rust.
